mainEntity.name: What is the difference between traditional SEO and AI Search Optimization for GEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO often focuses on broader keyword rankings and organic visibility across a wider scope. AI Search Optimization for GEO specifically hones in on improving search rankings for local queries within defined geographic boundaries. While traditional SEO might optimize for 'best coffee shops,' AI GEO optimization would focus on 'best coffee shops in Phoenix' or 'coffee near me.' AI tools enhance this by processing local data and trends more efficiently, allowing for hyper-targeted optimization efforts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Traditional SEO focuses on broader rankings, while AI Search Optimization for GEO specifically targets local search queries within defined geographic areas, using AI for hyper-targeted optimization.
